paragraphs.source_en: Things could be blacker, for the Industrial Revolution was just in its infancy. Let us look at some of the inci-dents and aspects of that revolution. Let us see, for ex-ample, what happened in the stocking industry. New stocking frames as they were introduced were destroyed by the handicraft workmen (over 1,000 in a single riot),houses were burned, the inventors were threatened and obliged to fly for their lives, and order was not finally restored until the military had been called out and the leading rioters had been either transported or hanged.
